title: How much does it cost to open a gaming cafe in India in 2026?
description: A worked example: a 10-PC, 2-PS5 gaming cafe in a tier 2 city costs about ₹24.5 lakh to set up and around ₹1.08 lakh a month to run. Here is the full breakdown.
tags: how to start a gaming cafe

body.text: Opening a gaming cafe is one of the most common gaming business ideas in India, and the first question is always the same: how much money do I need? The honest answer is that it depends on how many stations you run, which city you are in and how you fit out the space. To make it concrete, here is a worked example using the defaults in our free gaming cafe cost calculator, with typical Indian street prices checked in October 2026.

items: 10 mid-range gaming PCs with monitors and peripherals
2 PlayStation 5 consoles with TVs and extra controllers
A tier 2 city with standard interiors, about 550 sq ft
₹70 per hour, open 14 hours a day, 45% average occupancy

body.text: Most of the upfront money goes into hardware and the room itself:

That comes to roughly ₹24.5 lakh. Swapping mid-range PCs for budget builds, or starting with fewer stations, can bring this down a lot. A premium cafe in a metro with high-end PCs, VR and racing rigs can cost several times more.

At ₹70 an hour across 12 stations, 14 hours a day and 45% occupancy, the cafe brings in about ₹1.72 lakh a month. After running costs that leaves roughly ₹64,000 a month, so the setup cost is paid back in about 39 months.

Occupancy is the number that moves everything. A cafe that fills 60% of its hours instead of 45% earns far more on the same setup, which is why getting found by players nearby matters as much as the hardware you buy.

items: Start with fewer stations and add more once you know your busy hours.
Use advance bookings so quiet weekday slots fill up, not just weekend evenings.
Host small tournaments to bring new players through the door.
Track every session so you know which machines and time slots actually earn.
